Thirty evaluation seeds per scenario. F1 is pooled from event TP/FP/FN, not overlapping windows. All methods share source/response event detection; V2 uses an explicit event adapter, and Kernel screen uses an estimated FIR to screen candidate edges. Null cases have no true response events and therefore no recall/F1 comparison. Missing false-match fractions indicate no accepted pairs, not perfect precision.

Kernel timing errors use a single known stationary kernel only; adjacent/null cases have none. Widths and effective onsets use cumulative absolute kernel mass, not strict support or FWHM. Errors include every fitted kernel, without selecting successful runs.

Post hoc diagnostic of constant versus linear nuisance background within the same FIR model. This comparison was added after observing poor real-data extrapolation, and is not used to choose the reported main estimator or claim held-out validation for a revised model.
